observations: Five route checkpoints show the saved progression along the same porch; no visible camera penetration in those five images.
The final checkpoint approaches the existing gate-platform wall and does not traverse it.
The paving close view shows separated joints, restrained edge highlights and low-contrast mineral variation.
Lacquer and under-eave close views are dark; detailed carved patterns, actual site wear and hidden interiors are not reproduced.
The roof inspection view shows the retained continuous tile layout and restrained per-piece variation; it is a technical view rather than the lead gallery image.
limitations: Eight stills are not a complete animation playback or temporal-flicker review.
Local visual consistency is not photorealism or whole-city 1:1 verification.
